own_current_contracts.topic: Line identity and opaque row metadata
own_current_contracts.fact: readLines spreads originalLine and lineTotals spreads line, preserving lineId/sourceLineId/planAllocations/importedFrom/progress/custom. Plan/request assign unused L IDs, preserve existing IDs; linked legacy rows without IDs deliberately avoid new IDs. Generated purchaseorder rows already have PL IDs. Re-entry must use saved result and must not renumber/regenerate identity.

Actual own field is line.planAllocations, not sourceAllocations. GeneratedFrom=purchase-plan PO uses per-line many-plan allocations and planGeneration context, forbids combined sourceId; each allocation matches plan item/optional stable sourceLineId and warehouse, positive quantity, no duplicate source key; sum equals PO row quantity. UI disables generated item and quantity changes; preserves original allocation metadata. saveDoc forbids removing generatedFrom. Saving a retained PO is document update, not regeneration.

Remaining subtracts active child allocations by exact sourceLineId or legacy item fallback. validateLinks rejects inactive source with active child and over-allocation per item/per exact row. Plan generation recomputes candidate remainder and compares source/item/doc snapshot at commit. Retained plan edits must invalidate stale generation preview; retained PO edits must preserve purchase children/plan allocations and cannot shrink below downstream usage.

Own confirmation/progress are separate from special cancelled/held statuses. getDoc normalizes listed statuses from fields; plan per-line progress remains metadata. Confirmation affects active/remainder; generation excludes completed plan lines. Configured linked progress rules may update source document/plan line after save and revalidate. Plan/PO themselves are absent from stock movement posting branches; linked purchase remains separate. These are own policies, not original status formulas.

For retainSupported only, existing saves compare current in-memory DB document JSON with captured base. Latest reload explicitly discards own draft. commit evaluates cloned DB then persists localStorage before assigning current DB; failure returns false and save keeps controls. Existing plan/order generic capture currently skipped, while explicit list/hold/modal-close paths may separately store drafts. drafts/draftBases are in-memory maps, not durable browser-reload storage. Original server revisions/cross-client conflict handling are not implemented by this JSON check.

Main F7 saves then docEditor(type,result) only when retainSupported; plan F7 button is moved to secondary tools but form F7 key still calls save(true). For currently unsupported new plan/order, getDoc continues returning id undefined after F7 because re-entry is skipped; a subsequent save may create another document. This is a static control/data-flow risk, not executed reproduction. Supported extension must rebase saved ID/base before printing. Modal F7 closes then prints, a separate lifecycle that must be preserved.

required_acceptance_cases_not_run.case: New Save/Retain -> modify title + saved ID. Edit memo/price then repeat retain/F8; document count and sequence do not grow on update; all stable line IDs persist. Existing edit follows same ID. Modal key/baseline updates, close/reopen restores the correct saved document.

Distinct repeated item rows, per-line supplier/progress/custom fields and header dueDate/context survive retain, repaint/options, close/navigation. Legacy no-ID plan with existing legacy children keeps compatibility and remainder; linked request plan keeps sourceId/sourceLineId and locks. Adding rows gets unique IDs; renumbering/deleting allocated source IDs cannot silently lose provenance.

Generate PO from multiple plans, including same-item merged line and distinct sourceLineIds. Retain price/memo then repeat save: generatedFrom, planGeneration, row lineId, all planAllocations and importedFrom unchanged, no new PO/generation, plan remainder unchanged. Quantity/item locks persist after re-entry. Any forged removal/invalid allocation is rejected without persisted mutation.

Retained plan quantity cannot fall below generated PO allocation; allocated source-row/item/warehouse deletion/change cannot strand links. Retained PO quantity cannot fall below downstream purchases. Partial/full/cancelled/unconfirmed child cases use active allocation rules once; save does not double subtract. Plan/order leave stock unaffected; existing purchase stock does not duplicate.

Open generation preview then retain-edit source quantity/supplier/date/status; stale preview commit rejects, fresh preview reflects current source. Completion and per-line progress exclude candidates correctly; no blanket reset to 진행.

Preserve confirmation/progress, line progress, cancelled/held special status, custom/tax/supply policies. Test enabled linked progress rules and plan-line rule targets; retained view/source editors detect resulting changes. Accounted/closed-period/disabled-master/permission guards stay effective.

Two same-document editors/list or purchase-room update: stale retained save rejects while preserving unsaved controls; confirmed latest reload replaces draft and base. Missing original ID rejects; repeated valid retain rebases base so next edit succeeds. Cross-tab/server concurrency remains separately unspecified.

Form/core/provenance/stock/rule failure, localStorage exception and runtime permission loss leave persisted DB/document/sequence/allocations/remainder unchanged and keep edit controls. Retain never clears draft/baseline before successful persist.

After successful retain, edit then navigate/close/Escape/options repaint; correct saved-ID draft and original base persist in current app session. Reopen does not convert draft to a new document or overwrite a newer saved document; explicit reset/latest reload clears both maps. Do not claim persistence across browser reload.

New F7 -> print saved result, retained current ID/base; second F7 and later F8 update same document without duplicate IDs/count/allocations. Existing F7 refreshes base after persist. Modal F7 close/return and plan relocated button/keyboard tested separately. Print failure must not imply unsaved or trigger repeat creation.

Before product parity claim, root independently observes exact Save dropdown exposure for each screen; source binding/per-page overrides remain labelled unknown absent retained body/runtime evidence. No original Save or main-row interaction needed or authorized for this research.
